full_judgment:
2. The respondent No.1 as sole plaintiff instituted the aforesaid suit for declaration of his 'rayoti' right to the suit land and for khas possession thereof, stating inter alia, that he is the donor  member of Boalkhali Sirajul Islam College. While the plaintiff was a member of the governing body of the said college, he made a gift in respect of .32 acres of land from R.S. Plot No.7462 in favour of the said college but on 15-12-1986 the college authority trespassed into the suit land and included the same into the college boundary by putting bamboo fencing. The plaintiff objected verbally to the said illegal and forcible action of the college to the principal and to the founder Mr. Sirajul Islam Chowdhury requesting them to remove the fencing but to no effect and then served a notice upon the college authority through his lawyer on 29-3-1987 which was duly received by the defendants. The defendants gave a reply to the said notice making false and frivolous claim of title to the suit land in denial of the plaintiff's title and hence the suit. 

 4. The learned Assistant Judge dismissed the suit on the condition that the donor's list will he prepared by the college within 15 (fifteen) days including the name of the plaintiff in the donor's list, that is, by 12-1-1991 in default the suit shall be decreed. Against which the plaintiff preferred the aforesaid appeal and the same was heard by the learned Subordinate Judge, who allowed the appeal and decreed the suit in part declaring plaintiffs title to the 2 ka schedule land and also for recovery of his khas possession of the same directing the plaintiff to' execute a deed of gift in respect of the land schedule No.1 and also directing the defendants to prepare a donor list inserting the name of the plaintiff. The defendant No.1 (petitioner herein) being aggrieved moved the High Court Division in Civil Revision. After hearing the parties the Rule has been absolute by the impugned judgment setting aside the judgment and decree of the lower appellate Court and decreeing the suit of the plaintiff that is declared the title of the plaintiff of both the schedules of the plaintiff' and also for khash possession of the suit land. I fence is this petition.
